item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (71)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 71

  • Cull progress is a ring and a bar. Stop sits with that progress.
  • Show can list 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 stars on its own.
  • A cull keeps the Mac awake until it finishes or you stop it. Closing the lid can still sleep.
  • See trailsrg.com/apps/studio/versions for full notes
